step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element pi-model representing an on-chip spiral inductor. It includes the main series inductance (LS) and resistance (RS), feed-forward capacitance (CS), and substrate parasitic capacitances (CP1, CP2) and resistances (RSUB1, RSUB2).

paper_reference.title: A 0-dB IL 2140 30 MHz Bandpass Filter Utilizing Q-Enhanced Spiral Inductors in Standard CMOS

Inductance.description: Effective series inductance of the spiral inductor at the operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Extracted from the imaginary part of the input impedance (Z11) divided by angular frequency (omega).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper mentions 270 pH, which is a typical value for high-frequency RF inductors used in 2+ GHz LC tanks.

Quality_Factor.description: The Q-factor of the passive inductor at the center frequency (2140 MHz) before any active Q-enhancement is applied.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ratio of the imaginary part to the real part of the input impedance (Im(Z)/Re(Z)).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard on-chip spiral inductors in CMOS typically exhibit Q-factors between 5 and 15 at 2 GHz due to substrate losses and metallization resistance.

Self_Resonance_Frequency.description: The frequency at which the inductor's parasitic capacitance resonates with its inductance, causing the effective reactance to cross zero.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a small 270 pH inductor, the SRF is typically very high, well above the 2.14 GHz operating frequency, often exceeding 15-20 GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the effective inductance, quality factor at 2.14 GHz, and the self-resonance frequency (SRF) of the spiral inductor pi-model using a 1-port AC impedance measurement.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Spiral Inductor Pi-Model Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Component values based on typical 270pH inductor
.param val_LS=270p val_RS=0.5 val_CS=10f val_CP1=20f val_CP2=20f val_RSUB1=50 val_RSUB2=50

* DUT
CP1 P1 N1 {val_CP1}
RSUB1 N1 GND {val_RSUB1}
CP2 P2 N2 {val_CP2}
RSUB2 N2 GND {val_RSUB2}
LS P1 N3 {val_LS}
RS N3 P2 {val_RS}
CS P1 P2 {val_CS}

* Stimulus and Biasing
* Drive port 1 with 1A AC to directly measure Z11 as V(P1)
I1 0 P1 dc 0 ac 1
* Ground port 2 for 1-port measurement
V2 P2 0 dc 0
* Connect netlist GND to SPICE global ground 0
V3 GND 0 dc 0

.control
* AC sweep from 100 MHz to 50 GHz to capture SRF
ac dec 100 100MEG 50G

* Calculate Impedance, Inductance, and Q-factor
let omega = 2 * pi * frequency
let Z = v(P1)
let R_s = real(Z)
let X_s = imag(Z)
let L_s = X_s / omega
let Q_factor = X_s / R_s

* Measure metrics at the paper's center frequency (2.14 GHz)
meas ac L_2140MHz find L_s at=2.14G
meas ac Q_2140MHz find Q_factor at=2.14G

* Measure Self-Resonance Frequency (where reactance crosses 0)
meas ac SRF when X_s=0 fall=1

print L_2140MHz Q_2140MHz SRF
quit
.endc
.end
